description: Hello #TeamCastro! The hard work continues! I was recently designated a Target Race by the Democratic Legislative Campaign Committee, the only organization responsible for the national strategy to elect Democrats to legislatures across all 50 states! That means they believe in our campaign and know that winning in District 37 is critical to Democrats building power in the Gold Dome to get real work done for families in Georgia. As a top-tier Senate race, I've had the opportunity to attend several special events recently to meet potential supporters and learn from experienced public servants and industry leaders. We narrowed the gap with my opponent to 1 percentage point, raised $30,000 last quarter and have the support of faithful volunteers. That's getting this campaign positive attention! I give my word that I am a good steward of every donation received and every opportunity I have been given. Thank you to everyone who believes in me enough to invest in this campaign. If we are going to flip this seat, we need every ounce of support we can scrape together to mount a robust outreach campaign. That looks like contributions, stamp donations and volunteering. Thank you for your support as we are working HARD to win this race and help make Georgia a better place for all families! Darcy Castro Candidate for Georgia Senate District 37
title: News from Darcy Castro
